{{Short description|Dutch politician and environmental consultant}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=December 2018}}

'''Luuk Folkerts''' (born 1963) is a Dutch politician and [[environmental consultant]] serving since 28 November 2010 as [[Party chairman|chairman]] of the [[Party for the Animals]] (''Partij voor de Dieren'', PvdD), succeeding to party founder [[Marianne Thieme]]. Previously he was the PvdD's [[treasurer]] and a candidate on the lists for the 2007 election of the [[States-Provincial]] of [[Utrecht (province)|Utrecht]], the [[2007 Dutch Senate election|Dutch Senate election of 2007]] as well as the [[2010 Dutch general election|Dutch general election of 2010]], but was not elected to a seat.

Folkerts studied [[physics]] and worked at Ecofys, an international operating environmental consultancy, where he was dealing with matters of [[renewable energy]] and [[climate]] policy.
